title: RuntimeRun
description: P1a runtime/PID descriptor (SW-20260915-002 §8.9). Extends ADR-001 (Proposed) §3.3 with execution_zone_id and delegation/grant/epoch references — a recorded P1a amendment, not a freeze. Defaults to the session's home zone; a cross-zone run must record the explicit policy decision (decision_reason/policy_version).

pid.description: Platform-level opaque runtime id (ADR-001 §2.3), not an OS PID.

delegation_ref.description: Short-lived Nexus delegation reference the run operates under (P1a amendment).

grant_ref.description: ZoneGrant the run depends on (P1a amendment).

authorization_epoch.description: Zone authorization epoch the run was admitted under (P1a amendment).

decision_reason.description: Required when execution_zone_id differs from the session home zone: the explicit policy decision reason.
